description_ar: أسئلة مباشرة حول who/which/whose/where/when واختصار الجمل بـ V-ing و V3

questions.question_en: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: who. who for people (subject).

questions.question_en: The book ___ I bought is great.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: which. which for things.

questions.question_en: The girl ___ father is a pilot is my friend.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: whose. whose + noun shows possession.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: whose. whose + اسم للملكية.

questions.question_en: This is the house ___ I was born.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: where. where for places.

questions.question_en: The woman ___ in the corner is my boss.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: sitting. Reduced active clause: V-ing.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: sitting. اختصار جملة معلومة ← V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: اختصار الجملة: معلوم $\rightarrow V\text{-ing}$ ($\text{The man sitting...}$) ، مبني للمجهول $\rightarrow V_3$ ($\text{The car driven by...}$).

questions.question_en: The car ___ by my father is old.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: driven. Reduced passive clause: V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: driven. اختصار جملة مبنية للمجهول ← V3.
questions.memorization_note: اختصار الجملة: معلوم $\rightarrow V\text{-ing}$ ($\text{The man sitting...}$) ، مبني للمجهول $\rightarrow V_3$ ($\text{The car driven by...}$).

questions.question_en: My brother, ___ lives in Paris, is a doctor.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: who. After a comma we cannot use 'that'; for a person: who.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: who. بعد الفاصلة لا نستعمل that، للشخص who.
questions.memorization_note: الجملة غير المحددة بين فواصل ولا نستعمل $\text{that}$ بعد الفاصلة ($\text{My brother, who...}$) ، و $\text{that}$ بعد $\text{everything, all, nothing, the only, superlative}$.

questions.question_en: I remember the day ___ we met.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: when. when for time.

questions.question_en: He is the man ___ car was stolen.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: whose. whose + noun (car) shows possession.
Correct answer: that. After 'everything' we use that.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: that. بعد everything نستعمل that.
questions.memorization_note: الجملة غير المحددة بين فواصل ولا نستعمل $\text{that}$ بعد الفاصلة ($\text{My brother, who...}$) ، و $\text{that}$ بعد $\text{everything, all, nothing, the only, superlative}$.

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: written. Reduced passive: V3 (written).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: written. اختصار مبني للمجهول ← V3.
questions.memorization_note: اختصار الجملة: معلوم $\rightarrow V\text{-ing}$ ($\text{The man sitting...}$) ، مبني للمجهول $\rightarrow V_3$ ($\text{The car driven by...}$).

questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: Having finished. Perfect participle for an earlier action: Having + V3.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: Having finished. حدث سابق ← Having + V3.
questions.memorization_note: $\text{Having} + V_3$ (حدث سابق) ، $\text{Not} + V\text{-ing}$ للنفي: $\text{Not knowing the answer, he...}$

questions.question_en: The film, ___ we watched last night, was boring.
questions.question_ar: الفيلم، ____ شاهدناه ليلة أمس، كان مملاً.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: which. Non-defining clause with a thing: which (no that after comma).
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: which. جملة غير محددة لشيء ← which.
questions.memorization_note: الجملة غير المحددة بين فواصل ولا نستعمل $\text{that}$ بعد الفاصلة ($\text{My brother, who...}$) ، و $\text{that}$ بعد $\text{everything, all, nothing, the only, superlative}$.

questions.question_en: Not ___ the answer, he stayed silent.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: knowing. Negative participle clause: Not + V-ing.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: knowing. النفي ← Not + V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: $\text{Having} + V_3$ (حدث سابق) ، $\text{Not} + V\text{-ing}$ للنفي: $\text{Not knowing the answer, he...}$

questions.question_en: The children ___ in the garden are my cousins.
questions.question_ar: الأطفال ____ في الحديقة هم أبناء عمومتي.
questions.explanation_en: Correct answer: playing. Reduced active clause: V-ing.
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: playing. اختصار جملة معلومة ← V-ing.
questions.memorization_note: اختصار الجملة: معلوم $\rightarrow V\text{-ing}$ ($\text{The man sitting...}$) ، مبني للمجهول $\rightarrow V_3$ ($\text{The car driven by...}$).
